publication.title: Updating the Upper Cretaceous (Campanian) Two Medicine Formation of Montana: lithostratigraphic revisions, new CA-ID-TIMS U-Pb ages, and a calibrated framework for dinosaur occurrences
authors: J. Ramezani, E. M. Roberts, D. J. Varricchio

locality.name: PBDB collection 13282: coordinates are for nearby Egg Mountain, near Choteau, Montana. "This area is the traditional home of the Niitsítpiis- stahkoii (=Blackfoot/Niitsitapi ), Ktunaxa ?amak?is, and Salish Kootenai (Flathead) peoples."

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 13282 to Late Campanian with numeric bounds 83.6–72.2 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 89709; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.

claims.summary: PBDB occurrence 149984 records Lambeosaurinae in collection 13282, linked by PBDB to reference 89709.
PBDB stores the original/identified name as Lambeosaurinae indet. and the accepted name as Lambeosaurinae.
